backlog.spec: In the basin-hopping loop, keep a separate current packing cur, initialised to best. Each hop perturbs cur, not best. Accept the new packing as cur if its radius sum is >= cur's sum - 1e-7, so that the chain can wander across near-degenerate optima such as rattler moves. Update best only when the sum is strictly greater than best's. Every 20 hops without an improvement of best, reset cur = best.
backlog.title: Accept equal-sum hops to drift on plateaus

backlog.spec: Before the exact SLSQP solve in _solve_once, run one SLSQP pass on a smooth surrogate. Replace the pairwise non-overlap constraints with a single KS aggregate per circle: g_i = -(1/rho) * log(sum_j exp(-rho * slack_ij)), where slack_ij = dist_ij - r_i - r_j and the wall slacks are included, with rho ramped from 20 to 200 over two sub-solves. Feed the output into the existing exact-constraint SLSQP as the start point. The exact stage and _repair stay unchanged, so validity is still guaranteed.
backlog.title: Kreisselmeier-Steinhauser aggregated overlap stage

backlog.spec: Split the basin-hopping phase: for the last 25% of the total budget (time from 0.75*budget to budget), use hop sd HOP_SD/4 = 0.01 in place of HOP_SD. This gives an intensification phase of tiny perturbations that tunes the contact graph around the incumbent after the broader exploration. Keep the same acceptance rule (strict improvement of best).
backlog.title: Final fine-hop polishing phase

backlog.spec: In basin hopping, keep a running step sd starting at HOP_SD. Multiply it by 1.15 after a hop that fails to improve the best sum and by 0.85 after a success, clipped to [0.01, 0.1]. Use this sd for the noise.
backlog.title: Adaptive hop step size

backlog.spec: Give _solve_once a max_iter argument with default MAX_ITER. In the basin-hopping loop use max_iter=100. If the resulting repaired sum is within 0.002 of best's sum, run a second _solve_once from the resulting centres with max_iter=MAX_ITER and use that result. This screens bad hops cheaply and gives roughly 1.5x more hops in the same time.
backlog.title: Cheaper hop solves for more hops

backlog.spec: In the basin-hopping loop, with probability 0.5 pick k=2..4 random circles and reposition their centres uniformly in the square, leaving the others unchanged (plus small noise sd 0.005), then run SLSQP and repair as usual. Otherwise use the existing Gaussian hop.
backlog.title: Subset re-randomisation hop

backlog.spec: In the basin-hopping loop, draw the noise sd per hop as exp(uniform(log 0.01, log 0.08)) instead of the fixed HOP_SD. Keep everything else the same.
backlog.title: Log-uniform multi-scale hop sizes

backlog.spec: Check time.process_time() inside the restart pool loop and before each SLSQP solve in the hop phase, and break out as soon as the budget is reached. This removes the overshoot of a whole pool round past the 80 percent mark and uses any leftover time on one more hop. Keep the hard budget at TIME_FRACTION * time_limit so the 45 s CPU ceiling is never close. The only code change is the in-loop time checks.
backlog.title: Clock-guarded budget use

backlog.spec: Change POOL from 20 to 40 and KEEP from 3 to 2. The cheap L-BFGS relax screens more random starts, and only the two lowest-energy ones get the expensive SLSQP refine. The restart phase therefore spends its time on better-screened starts. Change nothing else.
backlog.title: Larger relax pool, fewer refined

backlog.spec: Change HOP_START from 0.4 to 0.2 so more of the 24 s budget goes to basin hopping from the best packing, which was the main gain in slot 8. No other change.
backlog.title: Replicate-free budget split tuning: HOP_START 0.2

backlog.spec: Rewrite the pair constraint as squared centre distance minus (r_i+r_j)^2 >= 0, which is smooth at zero distance. Keep the rest. The repair step remains the same.
backlog.title: Squared-distance pair constraints

backlog.spec: Set SHRINK from 1e-9 to 2e-10, which still passes the 1e-10 overlap tolerance given the repair makes pairs exactly touching. Verify with a final exact check in solve: if any pair violates by more than 1e-10, subtract 1e-9 from all radii.
backlog.title: Smaller repair shrink

backlog.spec: In the basin-hopping loop, with probability 0.5 perturb only the loosely constrained part of the best packing. Count each circle's contacts: pairs with centre distance minus radius sum below 1e-6, plus walls with gap below 1e-6. Pick the 6 circles with the fewest contacts (ties broken by smaller radius), move those with Gaussian noise of sd 0.08 and all other circles with sd 0.005, then run _solve_once as usual. Rattlers and under-constrained circles mark the regions where the packing wastes area, so the hop effort is concentrated there.
backlog.title: Slack-guided hop on loosely held circles

backlog.spec: In the basin-hopping loop, with probability 0.5 run the hop as two SLSQP stages. Stage 1 (maxiter 60) maximises sum(r ** q) with q drawn uniformly from {0.5, 2.0}, from the perturbed centres, under the same constraints: q = 0.5 favours equalised radii and q = 2 favours a few large circles. Stage 2 is the normal solve maximising sum(r), started from the centres and radii of stage 1. For q = 0.5 clamp radii with np.maximum(r, 1e-6) inside the objective to avoid nan. Implement this by giving _solve_once optional arguments for the objective exponent, the starting radii and maxiter.
backlog.title: Power-objective homotopy inside each hop

backlog.spec: Replace the constant HOP_SD = 0.04 in the basin-hopping loop with a deterministic schedule in elapsed time: sd = 0.07 at the start of the hopping phase, decaying linearly to 0.015 at the end of the budget, computed from time.process_time() at each hop. Early hops then explore neighbouring basins with larger rearrangements and late hops refine the incumbent locally. There is no feedback from acceptance rates and no randomised scale; only the formula for sd changes.
backlog.title: Linearly decaying hop size

backlog.spec: Change TIME_FRACTION from 0.8 to 0.92 so that both the restart phase and the basin-hopping phase get about 15% more time. The split stays the same because HOP_START is a fraction of the budget. Each SLSQP call takes well under a second, so the final call ends near 28 s, far from the 45 s void limit. Change nothing else.
backlog.title: Use more of the CPU budget

backlog.spec: Reduce HOP_SD from 0.04 to 0.02 so hops stay closer to the incumbent basin and more hops give small improvements. No other change.
backlog.title: Basin hopping step size HOP_SD 0.02

backlog.spec: After _relax returns a relaxed centre set for a start, scale its centres about (0.5, 0.5) by a random factor drawn uniformly from [1.00, 1.08], then clip to [INIT_LOW, 1-INIT_LOW]. The dilation spreads the relaxed configuration toward the walls and separates near-touching pairs before SLSQP. The factor is drawn from the seeded rng, and the pool ranking still uses the relaxed energy before dilation.
backlog.title: Dilated relaxed starts

backlog.spec: In the basin-hopping loop, with probability 0.5 replace the independent per-circle Gaussian noise by a spatially smooth random displacement field, so that neighbouring circles move together. Draw 3 random wave vectors k with integer components in {-2, ..., 2} (not both zero), random phases in [0, 2 pi) and random 2D amplitude vectors from N(0, 0.03^2); the displacement of a circle at centre c is the sum over the 3 waves of amplitude * sin(2 pi k . c + phase). Add a small independent Gaussian jitter of sd 0.005, clip centres to [0.02, 0.98], then run _solve_once as usual.
backlog.title: Smooth displacement-field hop

memo: Helped: two changes. Slot 3 (pool of 20 random starts relaxed cheaply, best refined) gave -2.9308/-2.9317. Slot 8 (perturbing the best packing after the first 40% of the budget) gave -2.9375/-2.9365, now the incumbent at -2.9370, about the published ~2.9370. Nothing since has beaten it beyond noise (sd ~0.0034). Did not help: two-tier restarts (-2.9204), perturb-and-repair (-2.9204), single-pass repair (-2.9246), greedy growth (-2.9331), hex seeding (-2.9355), warm starts (-2.9356), torus lattice (-2.9356). Within noise at -2.9375: MAX_ITER 1000, analytic Jacobians, best-of-4 hops, LP polish, shear hop, dimer move, centroid scaling. Unconfirmed single runs: slot 16 mirror-symmetric starts (-2.9386), slots 34 and 35 (-2.9386 each). Slot 21 crashed. Next: replicate slots 16, 34 and 35, since a gain of 0.0015 is still within noise. Then tune slot 8's knobs (40% split, perturbation size, circles moved) and the slot 3 pool size. Avoid more repair variants and new hop moves.
